messages.subject: not reasonable results
parts:
I am trying to run a correlated factor mirt model. Below is the code i used and I found the students don't have varying abilities. 

ColNames <- colnames(dat)
F1items <- ColNames[which(grepl(paste(PW, collapse="|"), ColNames))]
F2items <-  ColNames[which(grepl(paste(PW2, collapse="|"), ColNames))]
F3items <- ColNames[which(grepl(paste(PW3, collapse="|"), ColNames))]

model <- mirt.model(
  'F1 = F1items
  F2 = F2items
  F3 = F3items
  COV = F1*F2, F1*F3')

cmod <- mirt(dat.scores, model, itemnames=ColNames)
abilities <- fscores(cmod, QMC=TRUE)

The attached show the output results. All students have the same ability scores. I am not sure what went wrong.
